content: Sarai, en Eipram eh pwoud, sohte neitikihong Eipram. Ahpw mie eh lidu lih emen, mehn Isip, ede Akar.
Sarai eri ndaiong Eipram, “Kilang, KAUN-O sohte ketin kupwurehiong ie seri; dahme ke soh pekehikidahki ei liduwen? Mweinele e kak wiahiong ie emen serien.” Eipram ahpw pwungki dahme Sarai ndaiong.
Sarai eri kihong Eipram eh lidu Akar, mehn Isipo, pwe en pekehiki. (Met wiawiher sounpar eisek mwurin Eipram eh koukousoankiher nan Kenan.)
Eri, mwurin Eipram eh ale Akar oh kapwaiada reh nsenen pwopwoud, Akar ahpw liseianda. Eri, ni eh pehmadahr me e liseiandahr, e ahpw aklapalapkihla oh tapihada mwamwahlikihla Sarai.

Sarai eri ndaiong Eipram, “Kowe me kahrehda Akar eh mwamwahlikiniehla. I kihong uhk ei liduwet ke en pekehiki. Eri, sang ni ahnsou me e liseiandahr, e mwamwahlikiniehla. KAUN-O en ketin kupwurehda ihs me pwung rehta.”
Eipram ahpw sapengki, “Me mwahu. Kapwurewei omw liduwen, oh wiahiong nsenomw.” Sarai eri kapwurehla liduwo oh kin sakosakone, kahrehda Akar eh tangasang.
Tohnleng en KAUN-O ahpw tuhwong Akar limwahn pwarer en nan sapwtehn, nanial en kolahng Sur.
E ahpw mahsanihong, “Akar, en Sarai eh lidu, ke kohsang ia, oh ke kohkohla ia?” Akar ahpw sapeng, “I tangasang Sarai.”
Tohnlengo ahpw mahsanih, “Pwurala rehn liho, oh peki mahk reh.”
E ahpw pil mahsanih, “I pahn kangederehla kadaudokomw kan, oh uwen tohtowe sohte me kak wadekada.
Kereniongehr ke pahn naitikihada noumw pwutak emen, oh ke pahn kihong ede, Ismael,
pwe KAUN-O ketin karongeier ngilen omw apwal.
Ahpw mouren noumw pwutak en pahn rasehng mouren ahs lawalo men; e pahn uhwong aramas koaros, oh aramas koaros pahn uhwong. E pahn kousoan dohsang kiseh kan koaros.”
Akar eri mengimengloalki, “Mehlel, me I kilangehr Koht, I ahpw momourte?” Ih eri kamwarenki KAUN-O, me ketin mahseniong, “Koht Me kin Mahsanih Wasa.”
Ih kahrepen en aramas akan ar kin kahdanekihki pwarer me mi nanpwungen Kades oh Pered, “Pwarer en me Ieiaso Me ketin Mamahsanih Ie.”
Akar eri naitikihong Eipram pwutak emen; Eipram ahpw kihong ede Ismael.

footnotes.text: 16.11 ISMAEL: Ahd wet ni mahsen en Ipru wehwehki “Koht ketin karonge.”
